question: In a certain code language, G is written as 20 and E is written as 22. How will GREAT be written as in that language?
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55076ea54395deab263d9b051c59629eca76721df23f2e015a81f3f08dd2601e.png] 

The pattern followed here is 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e62b00219c4ce7ec90de8f8f62cfa038ffb2a400f426ae42cd7b39834bac25a2.png] 

So the G is coded as 20.

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d63ed20de50b018e9e2bb8bb32f20813f5bf6bbb0d0ca262f3f85ed8ddeb701a.png] 

So the E is coded as 22.

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5a31d8de41938c28ac7419138caf50cc5ce41d775b17f2a9417a2dc6e609fc3.png] 

Hence, GREAT is coded as** ‘20922267’.**
